label: S. 1157
title: Women and Lung Cancer Research and Preventive Services Act of 2025
short_title: Women and Lung Cancer Research and Preventive Services Act of 2025
summary: Women and Lung Cancer Research and Preventive Services Act of 2025 This bill requires the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) to conduct an interagency review and, as necessary, update federal activities related to lung cancer research, prevention, diagnosis, and treatment with respect to women and certain other populations (e.g., individuals aged 50-80 with a history of smoking). The review must analyze existing research and current knowledge gaps; identify new opportunities for collaborative research to determine the causes of lung cancer and advance prevention, screening, diagnosis, and treatment; and assess current public health strategies for lung cancer screening and diagnosis, including the need for more public awareness. HHS must report to Congress on the results of the review, including any identified knowledge gaps, resulting changes to federal activities, and recommendations for other changes.
